review.evidence: Official deployment and fund terms expressly permit direct tokenization of fund shares on all three networks. Fresh EVM owner, ProxyAdmin owner, implementation and Solana authority reads identify the adverse centralized mint paths. This differs from USTB Plume representation treatment: USCC current terms affirm direct tokenization on Plume. Cross-chain EVM burn/reissue is separately reviewed in Bridge Risk, and book-entry shares are excluded from the public token supply. No independent reserve-to-liability reconciliation or enforceable economic cap is claimed.
